subject: implementer
reason: Single service (Ordering.API), about 3 files: endpoint error mapping plus letting the domain exception through IdentifiedCommandHandler.
mode_reason: Single service (Ordering.API), about 3 files: endpoint error mapping plus letting the domain exception through IdentifiedCommandHandler.

items.goal: PUT api/orders/cancel and api/orders/ship return 409 Conflict (ProblemDetails with the domain message) for invalid status transitions, 404 for a nonexistent order and 400 for command validation failures, instead of 500; other failures stay 500.
items.modelReason: Error mapping across a MediatR pipeline; easy to get wrong without caller analysis, but not hard design work.
items.verifyReason: Backend-only HTTP status mapping; no UI.

alternatives.option: Change the cancel/ship command handlers to return a result type with an error reason instead of bool
alternatives.reason: Wider signature change across handlers, the duplicate-request handlers and unit tests; the exception passthrough is smaller and matches the Technical Notes.

alternatives.option: Global exception handler mapping OrderingDomainException to 409
alternatives.reason: Affects every Ordering endpoint, including create order (BUG-9's scope), and the bare catch in IdentifiedCommandHandler still swallows the exception.
